1.english_reference: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds , [ and ] with every leader .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּוָּעַ֣ץ דָּוִ֗יד עִם שָׂרֵ֧י הָ אֲלָפִ֛ים וְ הַ מֵּא֖וֹת לְ כָל נָגִֽיד
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο Δαυεὶδ μετὰ τῶν χιλιάρχων καὶ τῶν ἑκατοντάρχων παντὶ ἡγουμένῳ ·
traditions.VUL: Iniit autem consílium David cum tribúnis , et centuriónibus , et univérsis princípibus ,
traditions.KJV: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds , [ and ] with every leader .

2.english_reference: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְ כֹ֣ל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ Ἰσραήλ
traditions.VUL: et ait ad omnem cœtum Israel :
traditions.KJV: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel ,

2.english_reference: If [ it seem ] good unto you , and [ that it be ] of the LORD our God ,

traditions.WLC: אִם עֲלֵי כֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּ מִן יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י נוּ
traditions.LXX: Εἰ ἐφ᾽ ὑμῖν ἀγαθὸν καὶ παρὰ Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν εὐωδώθη ,
traditions.VUL: Si placet vobis , et a Dómino Deo nostro egréditur sermo , quem loquor :
traditions.KJV: If [ it seem ] good unto you , and [ that it be ] of the LORD our God ,

2.english_reference: let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , [ that are ] left in all the land of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל אַחֵ֣י נוּ הַ נִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּ כֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: ἀποστείλωμεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν τοὺς ὑπολελειμμένους ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: mittámus ad fratres nostros réliquos in univérsas regiónes Israel ,
traditions.KJV: let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , [ that are ] left in all the land of Israel ,

2.english_reference: and with them [ also ] to the priests and Levites [ which are ] in their cities [ and ] suburbs ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עִמָּ הֶ֛ם הַ כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ עָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετ᾽ αὐτῶν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευεῖται ἐν πόλεσιν κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et ad sacerdótes , et Levítas , qui hábitant in suburbánis úrbium ,
traditions.KJV: and with them [ also ] to the priests and Levites [ which are ] in their cities [ and ] suburbs ,

2.english_reference: that they may gather themselves unto us :

traditions.WLC: וְ יִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συναχθήσονται πρὸς ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: ut congregéntur ad nos ,
traditions.KJV: that they may gather themselves unto us :

3.english_reference: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us :

traditions.WLC: וְ נָסֵ֛בָּה אֶת אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֖י נוּ אֵלֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετενέγκωμεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν πρὸς ἡμᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: et reducámus arcam Dei nostri ad nos :
traditions.KJV: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us :

3.english_reference: for we inquired not at it in the days of Saul .

traditions.WLC: כִּי לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖ הוּ בִּ ימֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐζήτησαν αὐτὴν ἀφ᾽ ἡμερῶν Σαούλ .
traditions.VUL: non enim requisívimus eam in diébus Saul .
traditions.KJV: for we inquired not at it in the days of Saul .

4.english_reference: And all the congregation said that they would do so :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֥וּ כָֽל הַ קָּהָ֖ל לַ עֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία τοῦ ποιῆσαι οὕτως ,
traditions.VUL: Et respóndit univérsa multitúdo ut ita fíeret :
traditions.KJV: And all the congregation said that they would do so :

4.english_reference: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי יָשַׁ֥ר הַ דָּבָ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֥י כָל הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εὐθὴς ὁ λόγος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ .
traditions.VUL: placúerat enim sermo omni pópulo .
traditions.KJV: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .

5.english_reference: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּקְהֵ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן שִׁיח֥וֹר מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ עַד לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת לְ הָבִיא֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ קִּרְיַ֖ת יְעָרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκκλησίασεν Δαυεὶδ τὸν πάντα Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ ὁρίων Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἕως εἰσόδου Ἡμὰθ τοῦ εἰσενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ πόλεως Ἰαρείμ .
traditions.VUL: Congregávit ergo David cunctum Israel , a Sihor Ægýpti usque dum ingrediáris Emath , ut addúceret arcam Dei de Cariathíarim .
traditions.KJV: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim .

6.english_reference: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , [ that is ] , to Kirjathjearim , which [ belonged ] to Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֤יד וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔תָ ה אֶל קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ יהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτὴν Δαυείδ · καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἀνέβη εἰς πόλιν Δαυείδ , ἣ ἦν τοῦ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Et ascéndit David , et omnis vir Israel , ad collem Cariathíarim , qui est in Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , [ that is ] , to Kirjathjearim , which [ belonged ] to Judah ,

6.english_reference: to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: לְ הַעֲל֣וֹת מִ שָּׁ֗ם אֵת֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָ אֱלֹהִ֧ים יְהוָ֛ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν ἐκεῖθεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: ut afférret inde arcam Dómini Dei
traditions.KJV: to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD ,

6.english_reference: that dwelleth [ between ] the cherubims , whose name is called [ on it ] .

traditions.WLC: יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הַ כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שֵֽׁם
traditions.LXX: καθημένου ἐπὶ χερουβεὶν οὗ ἐπεκλήθη ὄνομα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: sedéntis super chérubim , ubi invocátum est nomen eius .
traditions.KJV: that dwelleth [ between ] the cherubims , whose name is called [ on it ] .

7.english_reference: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּרְכִּ֜יבוּ אֶת אֲר֤וֹן הָ אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה מִ בֵּ֖ית אֲבִינָדָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ ἅμαξαν καινὴν ἐξ οἴκου Ἀμειναδάβ ·
traditions.VUL: Imposuerúntque arcam Dei super plaustrum novum , de domo Abínadab :
traditions.KJV: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab :

7.english_reference: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart .

traditions.WLC: וְ עֻזָּ֣א וְ אַחְי֔וֹ נֹהֲגִ֖ים בָּ עֲגָלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ὀζὰ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἦγον τὴν ἅμαξαν .
traditions.VUL: Oza autem , et frater eius minábant plaustrum .
traditions.KJV: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart .

8.english_reference: And David and all Israel played before God with all [ their ] might ,

traditions.WLC: וְ דָוִ֣יד וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַׂחֲקִ֛ים לִ פְנֵ֥י הָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ כָל עֹ֑ז
traditions.LXX: καὶ Δαυεὶδ καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ παίζοντες ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει ,
traditions.VUL: Porro David , et univérsus Israel , ludébant coram Deo omni virtúte
traditions.KJV: And David and all Israel played before God with all [ their ] might ,

8.english_reference: and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ שִׁירִ֤ים וּ בְ כִנֹּרוֹת֙ וּ בִ נְבָלִ֣ים וּ בְ תֻפִּ֔ים וּ בִ מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם וּ בַ חֲצֹצְרֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ψαλτῳδοῖς καὶ ἐν κινύραις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις , ἐν τυμπάνοις καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐν σάλπιγξιν .
traditions.VUL: in cánticis , et in cítharis , et psaltériis , et týmpanis , et cýmbalis , et tubis .
traditions.KJV: and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .

9.english_reference: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἕως τῆς ἅλωνος ·
traditions.VUL: Cum autem pervenísset ad áream Chidon ,
traditions.KJV: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon ,

9.english_reference: Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת יָד֗ וֹ לֶ אֱחֹז֙ אֶת הָ֣ אָר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Ὀζὰ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τοῦ κατασχεῖν τὴν κιβωτόν ,
traditions.VUL: teténdit Oza manum suam , ut sustentáret arcam :
traditions.KJV: Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַ בָּקָֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέκλινεν αὐτὴν ὁ μόσχος .
traditions.VUL: bos quippe lascíviens páululum inclináverat eam .
traditions.KJV: for the oxen stumbled .

10.english_reference: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ עֻזָּ֔א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυμώθη Κύριος ἐπὶ Ὀζά ,
traditions.VUL: Irátus est ítaque Dóminus contra Ozam ,
traditions.KJV: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza ,

10.english_reference: and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכֵּ֕ הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖ וֹ עַל הָ אָר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ διὰ τὸ ἐκτεῖναι τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κιβωτόν ·
traditions.VUL: et percússit eum , eo quod tetigísset arcam :
traditions.KJV: and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark :

10.english_reference: and there he died before God .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥מָת שָׁ֖ם לִ פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ ἀπέναντι τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et mórtuus est ibi coram Dómino .
traditions.KJV: and there he died before God .

11.english_reference: And David was displeased , because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֣חַר לְ דָוִ֔יד כִּֽי פָרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּ עֻזָּ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠθύμησεν Δαυεὶδ ὅτι διέκοψεν Κύριος διακοπὴν ἐν Ὀζά ,
traditions.VUL: Contristatúsque est David , eo quod divisísset Dóminus Ozam :
traditions.KJV: And David was displeased , because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza :

11.english_reference: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֞א לַ מָּק֤וֹם הַ הוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν τόπον ἐκεῖνον Διακοπὴ Ὀζὰ
traditions.VUL: vocavítque locum illum Divísio Ozæ ,
traditions.KJV: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza

traditions.WLC: עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: usque in præséntem diem .
traditions.KJV: to this day .

12.english_reference: And David was afraid of God

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּירָ֤א דָוִיד֙ אֶת הָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Δαυεὶδ τὸν θεὸν
traditions.VUL: Et tímuit Deum
traditions.KJV: And David was afraid of God

traditions.WLC: בַּ יּ֥וֹם הַ ה֖וּא
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
traditions.VUL: tunc témporis ,
traditions.KJV: that day ,

12.english_reference: saying , How shall I bring the ark of God [ home ] to me ?

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר הֵ֚יךְ אָבִ֣יא אֵלַ֔ י אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: λέγων Πῶς εἰσοίσω τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς ἐμαυτόν ;
traditions.VUL: dicens : Quómodo possum ad me introdúcere arcam Dei ?
traditions.KJV: saying , How shall I bring the ark of God [ home ] to me ?

13.english_reference: So David brought not the ark [ home ] to himself to the city of David

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת הָ אָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖י ו אֶל עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστρεψεν Δαυεὶδ τὴν κιβωτὸν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν εἰς πόλιν Δαυείδ ,
traditions.VUL: Et ob hanc causam non addúxit eam ad se , hoc est , in civitátem David ,
traditions.KJV: So David brought not the ark [ home ] to himself to the city of David ,

13.english_reference: but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּטֵּ֕ הוּ אֶל בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹ֖ם הַ גִּתִּֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέκλινεν αὐτὴν εἰς οἶκον Ἀβεδδαρὰ τοῦ Γεθθαίου .
traditions.VUL: sed avértit in domum Obédedom Gethǽi .
traditions.KJV: but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite .

14.english_reference: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָ אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּ בֵית֖ וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν οἴκῳ Ἀβεδδαρὰ τρεῖς μῆνας ·
traditions.VUL: Mansit ergo arca Dei in domo Obédedom tribus ménsibus :
traditions.KJV: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months .

14.english_reference: And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom , and all that he had

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹ֖ם וְ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐλόγησεν ὁ θεὸς Ἀβεδδαρὰμ καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et benedíxit Dóminus dómui eius , et ómnibus quæ habébat .
traditions.KJV: And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom , and all that he had .
